task_description: Issue #45: add short Web Audio SFX for feed/train/battle-hit/win/lose/draw/evolution, plus an accessible Settings panel (SFX on/off, volume, reduced-motion app toggle, consolidated JA/EN language toggle) with localStorage persistence. Autoplay-policy compliant (muted by default; AudioContext created/resumed only on user gesture). Frontend-only change; README asset-license note in both README files. No new runtime deps.
